research_equation.one_sentence_thesis: Generic Shap-E provides a reusable implicit-3D latent prior, generic data underrepresents biomedical shapes, full LGM/LRM-scale retraining is unavailable, so Shap-MeD freezes the transmitter and fine-tunes the conditional latent diffusion on 3,589 MedShapeNet meshes.
research_equation.valuable_paradigm: Open-source generic text-to-3D generation through Shap-E implicit-function latents.
research_equation.broken_assumption: A generic object prior is sufficient for stable and anatomically plausible biomedical object generation.
research_equation.hard_setting: Biomedical domain specialization under limited compute and imperfect, imbalanced medical meshes.
research_equation.borrowed_tool: Domain fine-tuning of a pretrained conditional diffusion model.
research_equation.unavailable_mechanism: Large-scale, clean, medically annotated text-3D pretraining or full adaptation of LGM/LRM-scale models.
research_equation.surrogate_mechanism: Frozen Shap-E transmitter plus low-learning-rate fine-tuning of the generative model on MedShapeNet latents.

direction_reconstruction.starting_dissatisfaction: Generic text-to-3D systems can create ordinary objects but do not explicitly target biomedical meshes, while manual medical 3D modeling is costly.
direction_reconstruction.almost_worked_transfer: LRM and LGM offer stronger modern 3D generation/reconstruction quality, and Shap-E already exposes a reusable latent diffusion interface.
direction_reconstruction.blocking_constraint: The authors treat the original training compute of LRM/LGM as infeasible and have only a modest, noisy biomedical mesh subset.
direction_reconstruction.replacement_logic: Choose the lighter Shap-E, freeze its representation encoder, encode medical meshes once, and specialize only the latent generator.

challenge_module_map.challenge: Generic model lacks a biomedical shape prior.
challenge_module_map.failure_mode: Text prompts produce outputs that do not reliably resemble target organs.
challenge_module_map.design_principle: Specialize the existing prior rather than retrain a 3D representation.
challenge_module_map.module: MedShapeNet latent fine-tuning of Shap-E generative model.
challenge_module_map.ablation_or_evidence: Latent MSE decreases from 0.147 to 0.089, but no data-size or cleaned-data ablation is provided.

challenge_module_map.challenge: MedShapeNet STL meshes are incompatible with the Shap-E input pipeline.
challenge_module_map.failure_mode: Meshes cannot be encoded into Shap-E latents directly.
challenge_module_map.design_principle: Normalize the file interface before representation reuse.
challenge_module_map.ablation_or_evidence: Method description only; no geometry-preservation audit after conversion.

challenge_module_map.challenge: Full 3D representation training exceeds the intended resource budget.
challenge_module_map.failure_mode: Training scope becomes too large for the available hardware.
challenge_module_map.ablation_or_evidence: Single-A40 fine-tuning is feasible, but frozen versus trainable transmitter is not ablated.

challenge_module_map.challenge: Domain fine-tuning may erase generic generation knowledge.
challenge_module_map.failure_mode: Catastrophic forgetting of the pretrained diffusion prior.
challenge_module_map.ablation_or_evidence: Training is stable, but no generic retention test is reported.

challenge_module_map.challenge: Generated 3D quality is hard to evaluate.
challenge_module_map.failure_mode: A visually plausible object may still be geometrically or anatomically wrong.
challenge_module_map.module: Latent MSE plus Figure 11-12 visual comparisons.
challenge_module_map.ablation_or_evidence: MSE improvement is clear; anatomical superiority remains weakly supported.

module_lenses.failure_fixed: Larger candidate models are treated as unaffordable to adapt.
module_lenses.ideal_unavailable_solution: Adapt the strongest contemporary 3D generator under a fair compute budget.
module_lenses.available_proxy: A lighter open-source Shap-E checkpoint with implicit-function latents.
module_lenses.hidden_assumption: Shap-E capacity and representation fidelity are sufficient for biomedical anatomy.
module_lenses.future_direction: Compare parameter-efficient adaptation of Shap-E and larger models at equal VRAM, wall-clock, and data budgets.

module_lenses.failure_fixed: Full encoder and representation retraining is expensive.
module_lenses.ideal_unavailable_solution: A biomedical-aware encoder jointly optimized with the generator.
module_lenses.available_proxy: Generic Shap-E latent encoding of medical meshes.
module_lenses.hidden_assumption: The fixed latent space preserves domain-critical landmarks and topology.
module_lenses.future_direction: Measure representation adequacy with reconstruction, landmark, topology, and controlled unfreezing studies.

module_lenses.failure_fixed: No biomedical examples are present in the generic adaptation loop.
module_lenses.ideal_unavailable_solution: A large, clean, balanced, expert-verified, patient-linked text-3D corpus.
module_lenses.available_proxy: 3,589 aorta, liver, kidney, and heart meshes from a multi-source dataset.
module_lenses.hidden_assumption: Noisy category labels and damaged meshes still provide a useful biomedical prior.
module_lenses.future_direction: Run raw-versus-repaired-versus-expert-curated and source-held-out data studies.

module_lenses.failure_fixed: Generative quality lacks a simple quantitative score.
module_lenses.ideal_unavailable_solution: Direct, validated, task-specific anatomy and geometry evaluation.
module_lenses.available_proxy: Diffusion x0 prediction MSE on medical latents.
module_lenses.hidden_assumption: Lower latent MSE correlates with better anatomy and usable meshes.
module_lenses.future_direction: Calibrate latent loss against surface, topology, landmark, and expert metrics.

module_lenses.failure_fixed: Research inference is not directly accessible to a user.
module_lenses.ideal_unavailable_solution: A validated medical asset workflow with provenance, review gates, uncertainty, and usability evidence.
module_lenses.available_proxy: A local monolithic app that selects weights, accepts a prompt, and exports PLY.
module_lenses.hidden_assumption: A closed demo loop is a sufficient proxy for workflow utility.
module_lenses.future_direction: Measure time saved, failure rate, review burden, and safe rejection in education-focused user studies.

citation_logic.narrative_function: Direct method ancestor and implementation machinery.
citation_logic.assumption_inherited: Implicit-function latents learned on generic objects can represent medical shapes.
citation_logic.paper_move: Freeze the transmitter and specialize only the generative model on biomedical latents.

citation_logic.narrative_function: Historical field anchor and contrast boundary.
citation_logic.assumption_inherited: Diffusion and CLIP conditioning can connect text/image semantics to 3D generation.
citation_logic.paper_move: Prefer Shap-E's direct implicit-function latent generation over a point-cloud upsampling pipeline.

citation_logic.assumption_inherited: Larger modern 3D models offer better output fidelity but need more compute.
citation_logic.paper_move: Exclude them from adaptation and use LGM only as a small qualitative comparison.

citation_logic.assumption_inherited: Aggregated medical meshes are useful supervision for biomedical 3D learning.
citation_logic.paper_move: Select four categories while acknowledging label, hole, and imbalance problems.

citation_logic.assumption_inherited: Format conversion preserves the relevant geometry.
citation_logic.paper_move: Replace a conversion API limited to 50 meshes with an open-source batch conversion path.

experiment_story_map.claim_supported: Biomedical fine-tuning improves in-domain latent prediction relative to base Shap-E.
experiment_story_map.counterfactual: The improvement is not merely a visual presentation difference.
experiment_story_map.stress_condition: Evaluation on held-out biomedical latents, though source/patient splitting is unspecified.

experiment_story_map.claim_supported: Optimization is stable and both curves fall toward 0.09.
experiment_story_map.counterfactual: The final score is not produced by an obviously diverging training run.
experiment_story_map.stress_condition: Twenty-five epochs on a single A40, with no multi-seed variance.

experiment_story_map.claim_supported: A selected sample appears to become more organ-like over training.
experiment_story_map.counterfactual: Fine-tuning changes visible output rather than only a hidden loss value.
experiment_story_map.stress_condition: Only one liver and three checkpoints; seed and reference are unspecified.

experiment_story_map.claim_supported: Selected Shap-MeD samples have plausible silhouettes and fewer obvious disconnections than shown alternatives.
experiment_story_map.counterfactual: Base Shap-E or LGM alone may not produce equally clean examples for these prompts.
experiment_story_map.stress_condition: Only three prompts, incomplete baselines, and no standardized renderer or expert rating.

story_patterns.formula: generic prior + frozen representation + small domain corpus + conservative update -> domain prototype
story_patterns.lesson: When full model retraining is impossible, isolate a reusable latent bottleneck and adapt the smallest component that changes the output distribution.
A strong follow-up paper can be created by measuring where the convenient proxy stops predicting the real domain objective.

boundary_directions.title: Anatomy-aware loss and evaluation calibration
boundary_directions.hidden_assumption: Latent MSE is a reliable proxy for anatomy quality.
boundary_directions.what_breaks: Low-loss outputs may have wrong topology, branching, landmarks, or surface geometry.
boundary_directions.new_direction: Jointly measure and optimize surface distance, topology, landmarks, watertightness, and expert ratings; quantify correlation with latent loss.

boundary_directions.title: Verified geometry plus generative presentation
boundary_directions.hidden_assumption: A free-form generator can safely supply the geometry for medical education or planning.
boundary_directions.what_breaks: Plausible-looking meshes can contain wrong structures or connections.
boundary_directions.new_direction: Lock anatomy with a verified atlas, segmentation, or parametric scaffold and restrict generation to completion, texture, style, and presentation.

boundary_directions.title: Patient-specific multimodal generation
boundary_directions.hidden_assumption: Category prompts such as liver or kidney are sufficient for personalization.
boundary_directions.what_breaks: The system cannot represent a specific patient's geometry, pathology, or uncertainty.
boundary_directions.new_direction: Condition on CT/MRI-derived geometry and structured clinical metadata with OOD rejection and provenance.

boundary_directions.title: Medical mesh data quality as a causal variable
boundary_directions.hidden_assumption: Noisy multi-source meshes remain adequate supervision after coarse category selection.
boundary_directions.what_breaks: Mislabels, holes, duplicates, and imbalance become learned generative artifacts.
boundary_directions.new_direction: Compare raw, repaired, expert-curated, balanced, and source-held-out subsets under identical training.

boundary_directions.title: Equal-budget adaptation of newer 3D generators
boundary_directions.hidden_assumption: Original pretraining cost predicts adaptation feasibility.
boundary_directions.what_breaks: Parameter-efficient tuning may make larger models practical on the same hardware.
boundary_directions.new_direction: Benchmark LoRA or adapters across Shap-E, LGM/LRM, and newer generators at fixed VRAM, wall-clock, and data budgets.
